remarks:
Retreat to your own slice of heaven with this inviting 2-bedroom, 1-bath cabin, perfectly perched at the top of a hill on a quiet dead-end road for maximum privacy. Seller is willing to hold the note with the right terms. The welcoming front porch overlooks rolling hills, offering the perfect spot for fall leaf peeping, morning coffee, or peaceful moments year-round.
Only 3 years old and being sold fully furnished, this cabin is truly move-in ready, allowing you to enjoy the rest of summer and ease right into the beauty of the upcoming seasons. Currently set up to sleep 10, the property offers flexibility for guests, weekend retreats, or your own private getaway.
Additional features include a 1,000-gallon cistern with submersible pump for on-demand water and a 750-gallon tank for septic needs. A rare opportunity to enjoy privacy, comfort, and scenic views all in one charming cabin.
